thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> metering-emitter: EU collector-3 backlog > 2m, shadow vs live counts diverging. Potential customer overage flags. Paging @kevin oncall.
kevin: On it. Grabbing logs and recent writes. Any customer-visible alerts yet?
accounting-bot: 12 customers flagged for possible overage in the last 10m (threshold breach). No invoices charged yet, flags only.
sara: saw spike in emitter latency ~10:12UTC, looked like batching grew to 10s windows for that shard. Could be batching policy regression after yesterday's deploy.
kevin: running quick sanity query now:
```
SELECT region, count(*) as pending FROM emitter_queue WHERE shard='collector-3' AND state='pending' GROUP BY region;
```
kevin: result: EU=47k pending, US=120 pending. So it's isolated to collector-3 EU path.
leigh: collector-3 had a config tweak pushed in canary yesterday (batch.window.ms from 200 -> 2000). Reverting is fast if that's root cause.
maria: customer telemetry shows delayed usage surface (embedding calls) from several apps hitting EU. Some apps sent retries that could amplify counts.
kevin: reverting batching change now to 200ms. Patching via rollout tag "revert/emitter-batch-eu" -> starting.
incident-bot: deploy-bot -> rollout started: revert/emitter-batch-eu -> 3 nodes targeted in eu-collector.
kevin: reverted, reducing batch window. Watching queue drain. Current pending: EU=18k (down from 47k). Latency on emitter writes dropping.
accounting-bot: flags count falling: flagged customers now 3 (was 12). No billing processed.
sara: rolling back seems to help. We should enable fallback path that bypasses KV-aggregation for critical customers while we backfill.
leigh: enabling fallback for top-tier customers now (config flip). Will leave aggregation for lower tiers paused.
kevin: fallback enabled. Kicking off incremental backfill job for the 18k pending records. Backfill will be rate-limited to avoid double-counting; we'll mark backfilled IDs to dedupe.
maria: note — some retries sent duplicate request IDs, dedupe key is request_id v2; emitter has mixed versions. Backfill will need to apply heuristics.
kevin: implementing conservative dedupe (prefer first-seen timestamp) in backfill. ETA for full drain ~35m.
leigh: ops action items: 1) postmortem entry, include config diff. 2) add a canary that asserts batch.window.ms <= 500 for collector shards. 3) run customer impact recon and prepare comms.
sara: I'll start a short customer note draft (internal) and flag customer-success for pre-emptive outreach if any billing jobs run with these flags.
accounting-bot: manual checkpoint: hold automated invoice run for affected accounts for next 24h window. Finance acknowledged.
kevin: current state: collector-3 pending down to 2k, backfill running, dedupe in place, mitigation stable. Switching to oncall-handoff. @leigh you take next 30m.
leigh: taking over. I'll keep watch on drain, confirm no post-run surge. If pending increases again we trigger full rollback and page infra.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied (batch revert, fallback, backfill). Severity: S2 -> monitoring for customer impact.
kevin: filing short runbook entry in #eng-sre with query and rollback steps.
leigh: will open postmortem ticket with timeline and add owners.
sara: thanks team — nice quick rollback. Keeping customer comms ready and finance holding invoices.
accounting-bot: update: flagged customers reduced to 0, all flags cleared after backfill dedupe. Will verify final counts before unholding billing.
leigh: closing oncall handoff: still watching but moving from paging to notification. Will update thread if anything flips.
kevin: nudge to prod-safety: add a CI test for emitter batch config thresholds.
sara: noted. Postmortem owner: sara. Expected postmortem draft in 48h.
incident-bot: AUTO: incident closed for paging state. Follow-ups tracked in #postmortems.
